title: Unify credential-fencing + adaptive-retry telemetry and introduce generator-stream facade
author: Priya Nair
description:
This PR implements a cross-SDK cohesive approach to credential fencing, improves adaptive retry telemetry, and introduces a light-weight generator-based streaming facade for Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs. Motivation: multiple teams observed subtle retry storms during short-lived credential swaps and poor signal in observability for correlated auth+retry events. The goal is pragmatic: make credential transitions explicit (fencing), surface a small set of telemetry events to diagnose retry/auth interactions, and provide a simple generator/async-generator/chan-style facade that lets clients iterate over streaming chunks without dealing with low-level reconnect plumbing.

What this PR does (high-level):
- credential fencing: introduce an opt-in fence token in the auth surface that prevents mid-request credential churn from producing duplicate retries; implemented in SDK call pipeline (py/ts/go) and the shared session handshake adapter in the redwood core.
- adaptive-retry telemetry: emit unified telemetry markers (retry_attempt, retry_backoff_ms, credential_swap_start, credential_swap_end, stream_reconnect) so SRE and SDK owners can correlate traces and metrics. Events are emitted in minimal form to avoid cardinality blowup.
- generator-stream facade: add py: StreamGenerator/AsyncStreamGenerator, ts: streamGenerator()/AsyncStreamGenerator and go: StreamChannelAdapter that wrap existing streaming connectors with transparent resume and fence-awareness, exposing a single easy-to-consume iterator/channel pattern.
- compatibility and parity: keep legacy streaming callbacks and token-refresh hooks intact; this PR adds adapters and shims so existing clients keep working.
- documentation: upgrade notes and example patterns for short-lived credentials and build-time upgrade hints.

Checklist:
- [x] Design review with SDK leads (Evan, Sofia)
- [x] Unit tests for generator surface (py/ts/go)
- [x] Integration test that reproduces credential-swap race and validates fencing
- [x] Telemetry events wired to debug-level flag by default (off in production)
- [x] Docs and examples updated

Related work: Linear ENG-2242 (credential-fencing spec), ENG-2299 (telemetry schema), SUP-1187 customer incident with transient double-billing retries.

Notes on scope and risk: The fence token is opt-in via an SDK config flag (enable_credential_fence). Default remains off to avoid surprising behavior for older clients. The telemetry schema is additive and non-breaking. The generator facade intentionally abstracts away low-level heartbeat/heartbeat-retry knobs; advanced clients can still use the underlying stream handle if they need finer control.

Why cross-repo changes: While the core runtime change is limited, the observable improvements and ergonomics surface lives in SDKs. This PR modifies small surface areas in the redwood runtime (handshake adapter), and parallel SDK changes in sdk/python, sdk/typescript, sdk/go that map to the adapter. To keep reviews manageable the changes were bundled into this coordinated PR and split into logical commits.

review_comments: Evan Karp: Nice consolidation. Two asks: 1) make the fence opt-in (agreed), 2) ensure telemetry uses a low-cardinality tag set (done in markers.go).
Sofia Morales: Tests look good but please add an explicit unit test for partial-chunk resume when a credential swap happens mid-stream. (added test_gen_stream.py and adapter_test.go)
Dmitri Volkov: go adapter needs clearer docstring on channel close semantics — pushed a small follow-up commit to clarify and added example usage.
CI Bot: integration-tests failed on first run due to flaky network emulation; reran suite: all green.
Reviewer (Evan): Approved after minor nits fixed in docs and an extra telemetry test.
merge_details: Merged by Sofia Morales using squash merge. Commit message: 'Unify credential fencing + adaptive-retry telemetry; add generator-style stream facade across SDKs. [ENG-2242]'
release_notes: Added opt-in credential fencing to SDKs to prevent duplicate retries during mid-request credential swaps. New generator-based streaming facade for easier iteration over streaming outputs in Python/TypeScript/Go. Added telemetry markers to help diagnose auth+retry interactions. Backwards compatible by default (fence disabled).
notes_for_qa: To validate: run scripts/emulate_cred_swap.sh while streaming the echo example; observe single successful completion (no duplicate payloads) and telemetry events credential_swap_start/credential_swap_end around the swap. Ensure SDKs still accept legacy callbacks by running examples/streaming/legacy-callbacks.md.
